profile.headline: SWE at Meta | Post-Training Systems, Evals & Model Behavior
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Staff Software Engineer at Meta building systems for improving model behavior after pretraining.

Previously, I worked in Reality Labs as an XR Architect, leading architecture and R&D for AI-enabled AR/VR systems across eye tracking, bioauthentication, health features, and device sensor/system architecture.

Before Meta, I started the Organ Manufacturing Group at United Therapeutics and led engineering teams working toward transplantable organ manufacturing.

Across AI, XR, and organ manufacturing, I’ve focused on turning ambitious research into working engineering systems.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building systems for improving model behavior after pretraining, including RLVR and SFT environments, evaluation workflows, data pipelines, and post-training infrastructure.
Focused on the practical loop between environments, supervision, evaluation, and model improvement.

positions.title: XR Architect
positions.description:
Led architecture and R&D for AI-enabled AR/VR systems across eye tracking, bioauthentication, health sensing, and device sensor/system architecture.
Worked at the intersection of ML, sensors, compute, and product strategy to evaluate technical tradeoffs for next-generation consumer devices.
